note: City of Decorah Parks & Rec campground on the Upper Iowa River beneath limestone bluffs. The Twin Springs trout stream splits the Pulpit Rock side (sites 1-170) from the Twin Springs side (200-242), joined by a footbridge; the Hideaway row (301-319) is out by US 52. The RV loops sit back from the river behind the riverside tent sites (4-16), sites 109-116 nearest. Trout Run Trail to downtown. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 2026 rates $30-42 and the $3 booking fee, season Apr 1-Nov 1, 3-night holiday minimum, pull-throughs, showers, dump. Added 50 A, water/sewer false (electric-only sites, fill hydrants), 75 RV sites, Let's Camp booking link, some sites FCFS (38 of 75), 14-night maximum, flush toilets, potable water, wifi. Riverview kept: the river is ~45 m wide and the nearest RV loop is ~50 m back behind the tent lawn, no pads on the water. Pin in the north loop, fine.
flags: WATERFRONT (riverview kept): NAIP shows the Upper Iowa ~40-47 m wide at the campground (riverfront-class width). The nearest RV pads (east loop, sites 109-116 and the lot by 112-113, ~43.3002,-91.8078) are ~50 m from the riprap bank across the riverside tent lawn (tent sites 4-16) with scattered trees; no road between, no RV pad on the water. No official campsite photos were found to confirm the sightline, so this rests on imagery (open lawn with tree clumps). If AWH wants a stricter reading, the fallback is not waterfront, not on-water.

WATERFRONT LEAD (creek, unverified): on the city map the Twin Springs trout stream runs between the two sides with back-ins 133-136 and 224-226 ending near it; the stream is narrow (well under 30 m, creekside class) and under canopy on NAIP, so I could not see whether any pad reaches its bank. Not a basis for a change.

BOOKING ENGINE: the city's 'Reserve Site Online' button now goes to Let's Camp (letscamp.ca/camps/pulpit-rock-campground); its record lists open dates 2026-04-01 to 2026-11-15 against the city's April 1-November 1 season, and a 115-ft max RV length (an engine-wide figure, not used).
